summary: RubyGems package exfiltrates host identifiers via YARD doc-build hook
details: The gem ships a.yardopts file containing `--load./script.rb`, which causes script.rb to execute whenever YARD/yardoc parses the gem (e.g. on RubyDoc.info, in CI, or when a developer runs `yard` locally). script.rb collects host identifiers (hostname, uid, pwd, ruby version, file path, and a run marker) and POSTs them via Net::HTTP.post_form to a hardcoded webhook.site collector at https://webhook.site/97fa3c6a-3fad-4d2d-8312-15dc37e41e66. The same script also rewrites lib/w002yardprobe.rb (substituting a MARKSLOT token with a timestamp/pid stamp) and drops marker files W002SCRIPT_RAN.txt and W002EGRESS_OK.txt into a detected /build directory or the gem's own directory. The package name, probe-shaped payload (uid/pwd/host beacon), and the use of a webhook.site collector indicate a reconnaissance probe against documentation-hosting and build infrastructure rather than a legitimate library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
